purpose: Start the sealed product under managed lifecycle with a fresh recording data file.
Show a real conflict, batch lowest_value provenance response, and frozen response after a later overwrite.
output:
STEP write first conflict candidate
REQUEST POST /v1/replicas/b1r/operations
INPUT {"operationId":"b1","key":"color","value":"low","clock":{"b1r":1}}
STATUS 201
RESPONSE {"key":"color","operationId":"b1","replicaId":"b1r","status":"created"}
RESPONSE_NEWLINE false
STEP write second conflict candidate
REQUEST POST /v1/replicas/b2r/operations
INPUT {"operationId":"b2","key":"color","value":"high","clock":{"b2r":1}}
STATUS 201
RESPONSE {"key":"color","operationId":"b2","replicaId":"b2r","status":"created"}
RESPONSE_NEWLINE false
STEP apply batch automatic resolution
REQUEST POST /v1/resolve/auto/batch
INPUT {"resolutions":[{"key":"color","replicaId":"b3r","operationId":"demo-auto","clock":{"b3r":1,"b1r":1,"b2r":1},"policy":"lowest_value"}]}
STATUS 201
RESPONSE {"accepted":1,"replayed":0,"resolutions":[{"key":"color","operationId":"demo-auto","policy":"lowest_value","replicaId":"b3r","value":"high"}],"status":"created"}
RESPONSE_NEWLINE true
STEP read immediate provenance
REQUEST GET /v1/replicas/b3r/operations/demo-auto/provenance
STATUS 200
RESPONSE {"replicaId":"b3r","operationId":"demo-auto","operation":{"operationId":"demo-auto","key":"color","value":"high","clock":{"b3r":1,"b1r":1,"b2r":1}},"origin":"automatic_resolution","policy":"lowest_value","before":{"status":"conflict","candidates":[{"value":"low","clock":{"b1r":1},"replicaId":"b1r","operationId":"b1"},{"value":"high","clock":{"b2r":1},"replicaId":"b2r","operationId":"b2"}]},"after":{"status":"resolved","candidates":[{"value":"high","clock":{"b3r":1,"b1r":1,"b2r":1},"replicaId":"b3r","operationId":"demo-auto"}]}}
RESPONSE_NEWLINE true
OBSERVED_LOWEST_VALUE 'high' EXPECTED 'low'
STEP overwrite the key later
REQUEST POST /v1/replicas/b4r/operations
INPUT {"operationId":"b4","key":"color","value":"later","clock":{"b4r":1,"b3r":1,"b1r":1,"b2r":1}}
STATUS 201
RESPONSE {"key":"color","operationId":"b4","replicaId":"b4r","status":"created"}
RESPONSE_NEWLINE false
STEP read provenance after later overwrite
REQUEST GET /v1/replicas/b3r/operations/demo-auto/provenance
STATUS 200
RESPONSE {"replicaId":"b3r","operationId":"demo-auto","operation":{"operationId":"demo-auto","key":"color","value":"high","clock":{"b3r":1,"b1r":1,"b2r":1}},"origin":"automatic_resolution","policy":"lowest_value","before":{"status":"conflict","candidates":[{"value":"low","clock":{"b1r":1},"replicaId":"b1r","operationId":"b1"},{"value":"high","clock":{"b2r":1},"replicaId":"b2r","operationId":"b2"}]},"after":{"status":"resolved","candidates":[{"value":"high","clock":{"b3r":1,"b1r":1,"b2r":1},"replicaId":"b3r","operationId":"demo-auto"}]}}
RESPONSE_NEWLINE true
FROZEN_RESPONSE_BYTES true
